note: Ground-floor quantities room (1): parts, pieces and round numbers. Feminine nouns on the left, masculine on the right (entier, an adjective, sits on the left near the middle). The wooden door on the far left goes back to the entrance hall; the wooden door on the far right leads on to the second quantities room.
